# JHora v8 Ashtakavarga (BAV/SAV) Cross-Chart Oracle — Sulabh, Surbhi, Sheridan

## Header

- **Source:** Jagannatha Hora v8 (Windows), Strengths tab → Ashtakavarga → D-1 of the Natal Chart.
- **Captured:** 2026-07-06 (Session 54).
- **Reference sign:** natal lagna, per chart (see `jhora_david_ashtakavarga.md`'s
  CRITICAL provenance note — JHora's "Select the reference" dialog states the
  chosen sign "will be used as lagna when finding ashtakavarga"; the reference
  sign drives the lagna-contribution bindus, and BAV row totals / SAV grand
  total (337) are position-invariant and CANNOT detect a wrong reference sign
  by themselves).
- **Layout:** South Indian fixed-sign grid transcription, each chart
  individually checksum-validated at capture (21 checksums per chart: 8 BAV
  row totals + 12 SAV column sums + grand total 337).
- **Sheridan additionally validated by lagna-shift differential:** an invalid
  Aries-reference capture differed from the Taurus-reference (correct natal
  lagna) capture by exactly the theoretical Lagna-column shift vector implied
  by PVR Tables 19-25, across all 12 signs — an independent structural check
  beyond the checksums, specific to this chart.
- **Status:** ACTIVE oracle for cross-chart BAV/SAV parity tests.
- **Note:** the per-planet BAV rows below are also the designated oracle for
  future transit/kakshya scoring work.

## Cross-reference: old Sulabh SAV grid (jhora_sulabh.md, Session 27)

That grid's reference sign was undocumented at capture (Session 27, before
the reference-sign dependency was discovered in Session 54). Decoded from
its South Indian fixed-grid screen positions to Aries-absolute order and
compared against this file's Chart 1 (Sulabh, reference=Sagittarius) SAV
row: **the two are identical, cell-for-cell**, across all 12 signs
(`[25,25,18,26,28,33,33,25,28,36,31,29]` both). This strongly suggests the
Session 27 capture also happened to use the natal lagna (Sagittarius) as
reference, even though it was never recorded — but per the reference-sign
provenance concern, this file (checksum-validated, reference explicitly
documented) is the authoritative source going forward; see
`jhora_sulabh.md`'s superseded-grid annotation.
